_meta.purpose: Target marginals for the Agent 1 synthetic invoice/payment generator. Every value is copied from a primary document read on 2026-09-19; nothing is inferred.
_meta.primary_source: Atradius Payment Practices Barometer - B2B payment practices trends - Vietnam 2025 (PDF, 14 pages). Survey fielded in the second half of Q2 2025.

sample.method: Computer-assisted web interviews, international internet panel, accounts-receivable contacts

caveats: Perception survey of 300 firms, not transaction data.
Only three industries (steel and metals, textile and clothing, plastic and rubber); about half of respondents are medium-large or large.
Single time point; treat every value as a prior with an uncertainty band, not as ground truth.

Delay length beyond terms is reported only qualitatively ('about one month'); the tail shape must come from other sources (UK PPR buckets, Coface APAC ultra-long delays) and be run as a sensitivity range.

fields: % Invoices not paid within agreed terms
% Invoices not paid due to dispute
uk_payment_practices_reporting.note: Use the bucket shares to fit the delay-distribution shape; large UK payers, not Vietnamese SMEs.

coface_asia_payment_survey_2025.ultra_long_delay_definition: more than 180 days and more than 2 percent of annual revenue

xero_small_business_insights.note: Statistics cover fully paid invoices only and exclude invoices paid more than one year after issue, so they understate delay (survivor bias). Use as a lower bound.

vat_declaration_deadlines.quarterly_filers: last day of the first month of the following quarter
vat_declaration_deadlines.per_occurrence: within 10 days of the taxable event
vat_declaration_deadlines.weekend_or_holiday_rule: moves to the next working day
vat_declaration_deadlines.source: Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH14, Article 44 (effective 2020-07-01), as summarised by Vietnamese legal portals; verify against the statute text before production use

mandatory_insurance_contribution_2026.source: Vietnamese legal-portal summaries of the 2024 Social Insurance Law; verify current decree before use
